Question: jab taqdeer me pahele se hi sab kuch likh rakha hai to hame mahenat karne ki kya jaroorat hai.pls repl early. Answer ID: 8537 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2094/1656=H/1429) One neither knows what is written in one?s destiny nor is one asked to do what is written there. We are asked to strive in the matters commanded by Allah and His Messenger; therefore we need to work. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
